ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75-80% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the lobe interiors; 20-25% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the trailing edges, lateral tips, and central peduncle region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black patch extending from the peduncle towards the median notch. Wide high-intensity white fields covering the majority of the left and right lobes. Continuous black pigmentation band along the trailing edge. Visible tan/yellowish pixel mottling distributed across the white fields, particularly dense on the left mid-lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression centrally located, dividing the lobes with a depth approximately 1/8th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and serrated; continuous series of small pixel peaks and valleys along the entire horizontal boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly concave trajectory originating from the median notch and extending toward the lateral tips along the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, dark, textured clusters visible at the extreme distal tips (left and right) of the flukes, consistent with barnacle colonization sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of textured growths (barnacles) on both distal tips; widespread yellowish staining/biofilm across the white ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Water spray and droplet occlusion at the lower-central region where the fluke meets the water surface, obscuring fine detail in the immediate area of the peduncle.
